items.name: analyze_dependencies
items.description: Generate a prompt to analyze architecture and dependency structure of a workspace

items.name: cohesion_analysis
items.description: Generate a prompt that guides SRP analysis using cohesion metrics, identifies extraction candidates, and plans type splits

items.name: consumer_impact
items.description: Generate a prompt that analyzes the consumer/dependency graph for a type to assess the impact of refactoring it

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

items.name: dead_code_audit
items.description: Generate a prompt that guides a dead code audit using unused symbol detection and removal tools.

items.name: debug_test_failure
items.description: Generate a pure-template prompt that walks the agent through running tests and diagnosing failures. Renders instructions only — the caller is responsible for invoking `test_run` / `test_related_files` and passing the results into the analysis step.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.description: Optional: test filter expression to narrow which tests to run

items.name: discover_capabilities
items.description: Generate a prompt that helps an agent discover relevant server tools and workflows for a given task category.

arguments.name: taskCategory
arguments.description: Task category: refactoring, analysis, security, testing, editing, navigation, project-mutation, scaffolding, or all

items.name: explain_error
items.description: Generate a prompt to explain a compiler diagnostic error and suggest fixes. Uses a 20 s soft cap on the diagnostic-detail lookup so a slow analyzer pass aborts cleanly with an actionable message instead of hanging through the framework's default timeout.

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

items.name: fix_all_diagnostics
items.description: Generate a prompt that batches diagnostic cleanup using code-fix and validation tools.

arguments.name: severityFilter
arguments.description: Optional: severity filter such as error, warning, or info

items.name: guided_extract_interface
items.description: Generate a prompt that guides interface extraction and consumer updates across a solution.

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file containing the target type

arguments.name: typeName
arguments.description: Name of the concrete type to extract an interface from

arguments.name: targetProjectName
arguments.description: Optional: target project for the extracted interface

items.name: guided_extract_method
items.description: Generate a prompt for extract-method refactoring with data-flow and control-flow checks.

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

items.name: guided_package_migration
items.description: Generate a prompt that walks a package migration across all affected projects.

items.name: msbuild_inspection
items.description: Generate a prompt for evaluating MSBuild properties and items for a project file.

arguments.name: projectFilePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the .csproj or project file

arguments.name: propertyName
arguments.description: Optional: a single property name to evaluate (e.g. TargetFramework, OutputPath)

arguments.name: itemType
arguments.description: Optional: MSBuild item type to list (e.g. Compile, PackageReference)

items.name: refactor_and_validate
items.description: Generate a prompt that composes code-action preview/apply with validation steps for a focused refactoring. Uses a 20 s soft cap and a Warning severity floor so a slow analyzer pass aborts cleanly with an actionable message instead of hanging through the framework's default timeout.

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

arguments.name: endLine
arguments.description: Optional: 1-based end line number for a selection range

arguments.name: endColumn
arguments.description: Optional: 1-based end column number for a selection range

items.name: refactor_loop
items.description: Generate a prompt that walks an agent through the standard refactor → preview → apply-with-verify → validate_workspace loop using v1.17/v1.18 primitives. Mirrors the `refactor-loop` Claude Code skill so non-Claude clients have the same workflow.

arguments.name: intent
arguments.description: Natural-language refactor intent (e.g. 'rename GetUser to GetUserAsync and propagate to mappers').

items.name: review_complexity
items.description: Generate a prompt that guides a complexity review to identify and address high-complexity code.

items.name: review_file
items.description: Generate a prompt to perform a code review on a file

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

items.name: review_test_coverage
items.description: Generate a prompt that guides a test coverage review using test discovery, execution, and coverage tools.

items.name: security_review
items.description: Generate a pure-template prompt that walks the agent through a comprehensive security review. Renders instructions only — the caller is responsible for invoking `security_analyzer_status`, `security_diagnostics`, and `nuget_vulnerability_scan` in sequence and feeding their structured results into the triage step.

items.name: session_undo
items.description: Generate a prompt for inspecting session mutations and undoing the last apply operation.

items.name: suggest_refactoring
items.description: Generate a prompt to analyze code and suggest refactorings

arguments.name: filePath
arguments.description: Absolute path to the source file

arguments.name: startLine
arguments.description: Optional: start line to focus on

arguments.name: endLine
arguments.description: Optional: end line to focus on
